description: Change creator mode, your marketing email preference, the default ad formats for your videos and films (Earn page), and/or add the advertiser side to a creator account (add_side: advertiser; it then shows the advertiser side) or the creator side to an advertiser account (add_side: creator, with creator_mode). Only subscribe when the user explicitly asks. Does not change email, password, billing or payout settings.

ad_formats.description: The ad formats that may show on your videos and films unless one sets its own: banner, overlay, pause, end_screen, pre_roll; [] = none; null = Vidreno's default.

add_side.description: Add the other side to this account, as Settings → Start advertising / Start creating does.

name: update_account_settings
title: update account settings
